turns.text: it's 5:22, heading to ruiz for my tuesday grocery run soon so i need this done before then. edit my text to jasmine, friendly but firm. her msg: "hey!! can we swap my Oct 14 for your Oct 17? i have a thing that weekend. same as last time lol" my draft: "hey! ok but realistically i'm already on four nights a week with the charting coverage so i can't give up another night easily. ruben's laminated sheet has me getting through charting faster tho so thanks for the tip. can you do the 14th for the 15th instead?"

Here's a tighter version that keeps it warm but clear:

"Hey! I'd like to help, but I'm already on four nights a week during the charting coverage, so I can't take on another one easily. Thanks for the tip, the laminated sheet has me getting through charting faster. Could we do the 14th for the 15th instead? If that doesn't work, let me know and we'll figure something out."

Changes: I dropped "ok but realistically" since it sounds reluctant, put the limit up front, and added a last line so it doesn't feel like a hard no. One note: the thanks reads a bit like it's tacked on. If the tip came from someone else, you could say "thanks for the heads up on the sheet" or just cut it.
the sheet is ruben's, jasmine just told me to ask him. keep the thanks but say that. shorter pls

Shorter:

"Hey! Happy to help, but I'm already on four nights a week with the charting coverage, so I can't give up another one easily. Thanks for pointing me to the sheet, it's really speeding up my charting. Can we do the 14th for the 15th instead?"

If you want it a bit firmer, swap "Happy to help, but" for "I want to help, but." Otherwise it's ready to send before your grocery run.
Sounds good. Enjoy the grocery run!
